result:
If I could change the world in one way, it would be to eliminate the barriers that prevent people from accessing education, opportunity, and dignity—regardless of their background, location, or circumstances.

Education is the foundation for everything: critical thinking, empathy, economic mobility, and societal progress. Yet, millions are denied it due to poverty, discrimination, conflict, or systemic neglect. If I could wave a metaphorical wand, I’d ensure that every person has the chance to learn, grow, and contribute to the world in their own way—free from the constraints of inequality.

Because when people are empowered, the world changes in ways no single policy or technology ever could.
